title: Governed generated-artifact writer activation and run observation

phases.objective: Make the trusted dispatcher fail closed unless the registered governed writer is active and a concrete workflow_dispatch run is observed after GitHub accepts the request.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted pull-request operator and GitHub Actions dispatcher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A trusted /refresh-generated-artifacts command or explicit dispatcher workflow input bound to an exact work-branch SHA
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dispatcher either records an observed governed writer run ID or publishes a blocking structured finding instead of treating HTTP 204 alone as execution evidence.
steps: Validate trusted actor, same-repository pull request, exact source head, governed branch, explicit refresh label, and typed confirmation.
Read the registered governed writer workflow state through the Actions API.
Reactivate the registered workflow when it is disabled and fail closed when activation cannot be confirmed.
Poll only the registered writer workflow for a bounded window and only for runs created after the request.
Publish delegated_run_id and delegated_run_observed=true only when a concrete run appears.
Publish delegated_workflow_run_not_observed when GitHub returns HTTP 204 but no writer run appears.
Upload and publish the structured decision before enforcing it.
assertions: HTTP 204 is transport acceptance and is not sufficient evidence that the writer executed.
A disabled writer is explicitly reactivated before dispatch.
A writer that remains inactive blocks the dispatcher.
Run observation uses the workflow-scoped Actions endpoint, event=workflow_dispatch, branch=main, and a request-time lower bound.
The observation loop is bounded and cannot wait indefinitely.
Passed evidence contains a numeric delegated_run_id.
Missing delegated execution produces a blocking canonical finding.
The dispatcher remains contents-read-only and performs no direct repository mutation or force push.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and secrets_included remains false.

phases.objective: Observe one trusted command publish the exact delegated writer run ID and the subsequent canonical apply report.
Exercise disabled workflow, activation refusal, HTTP rejection, HTTP 204 without run creation, stale head, and absent label paths without repository mutation.
This repository-control repair performs no external provider or deployment canary.
This repair grants no migration, deployment, Production, provider, credential, or external publication authority.
